changelog:
## What's new in v0.9.0

### Workspace UI
- **Cookbook** — local model pulls (Hugging Face / Ollama / BitNet) plus **12 guided recipes** (RAG, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation, deployment).
- **Compare** — blind A/B model comparison with prefill from Cookbook.
- **Deep research** — dedicated research workflow panel.
- **Notes** — user notes panel in the desktop app.

### Embedded documentation
- Multi-page user guide in the **Doc** tab (sidebar navigation); `GET /api/docs` index + per-page markdown.

### Channels & plugins
- **Matrix** and **CalDAV** sidecar channel plugins in the public catalog (5 plugins).

### Code Studio
- Install via npm: `npx akasha-code-studio@0.9.0` (daemon on port 3876 required).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/azerothl/Akasha/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0
